citations.name: habeas:coverage
citations.commentary:
Formatting requires a value of the uninhabited UnreadContents type.
 This empty match has no executable case; storage tests deliberately
 supply no content values and reject node reads at the domain boundary.

rationale: The `habeas:coverage` citation sits on an explicit function with a body, `crates/habeas-sdk/tests/storage.rs#impl[UnreadContents/NodeContents]/fn[format]`, and its fenced commentary gives a substantive reason for the coverage exception. `UnreadContents` is declared as `enum UnreadContents {}`, so it has no values. `format(&self)` is `match *self {}`, which has no executable case and cannot be called. The commentary matches the source. `type NodeContent = UnreadContents` in `impl[StoredGraph/Domain]` is there to satisfy the associated-type bound. `impl[StoredGraph/Domain]/fn[node_content]` panics with "storage operations must not read graph contents", so the storage tests do reject node reads at the domain boundary. The citation is a `cite` role, which is the one the built-in permits. The function has no `impl` or `test` reference to the same item, so the citation is not redundant.
